name: Error Slack
description: Sample error workflow: posts failed triggered runs to a Slack incoming webhook (secret variable ALERT_SLACK_URL). Enable 'Post to Slack' after setting it. It also posts when the workflow runs successfully again (Recovery Trigger).

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Disabled until set up: define the secret variable ALERT_SLACK_URL (Slack app › Incoming Webhooks).

body.text: :rotating_light: *{{ $json.workflow.name }}* failed ({{ $json.execution.environment }}) in node {{ $json.subWorkflow ? $json.subWorkflow.name + ' › ' + ($json.subWorkflow.node?.name ?? '-') : ($json.node?.name ?? '-') }}: {{ $json.execution.error }}{{ $json.suppressed > 0 ? ' (+' + $json.suppressed + ' more since the last message)' : '' }}{{ $json.execution.url ? ' <' + $json.execution.url + '|Open the run>' : '' }}

nodes.name: Slack Recovered
nodes.notes: Disabled until set up, like Slack: define the secret variable ALERT_SLACK_URL.

body.text: :white_check_mark: *{{ $json.workflow.name }}* is running again ({{ $json.execution.environment }}). Failing since {{ $json.failedSince }}, {{ $json.failures }} failed run(s).
